Max's birthday is in December. Max is interested in reading. Amy hopes to visit London one day. For example, practice is important.
Amy plays tennis with Max every Monday. Amy thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Both of them like chicken and milk. The footpath winds down to the bay.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the train station by bike. Amy bought a pair of shoes at the shop yesterday. Life is full of small surprises. Also, the light rail crosses the river twice.
The weather was snowy that day. Last Monday, Amy and Max went to the train station. They took many photos at the hotel.
